Senior Digital Product Manager, Product Operations \- Playbook \& Training


**What you will do**


The Senior Product Manager, Product Operations \- Playbook \& Training will help scale Amgen’s Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM) by creating, maintaining, and facilitating the practical materials teams need to adopt product ways of working. Reporting to the Director, Product Operations, this individual contributor role will own DPOM playbook content, product management standards, templates, examples, self\-serve guides, formal training, and accelerator workshops that help product teams, product groups, and business functions apply DPOM consistently.


This role will translate product management practices into clear, usable, enterprise\-ready guidance. The Senior Product Manager, Product Operations \- Playbook \& Training will create materials that help teams define product vision and strategy, understand user and business problems, develop roadmaps, define OKRs and KPIs, prioritize opportunities, conduct discovery, clarify roles and decision rights, and connect product work to measurable outcomes.


This role will partner closely with Product Management Catalysts to convert real examples, lessons learned, and field\-tested practices into reusable assets, while owning version control, socialization, and distribution of DPOM materials across the enterprise.


**Responsibilities**


DPOM Playbook and Product Management Standards

* Translate complex product management concepts into practical tools that teams can use without heavy interpretation.


* Own version control, content hygiene, distribution, and socialization of DPOM materials across relevant enterprise channels.


Training and Accelerator Workshops


* Design and facilitate formal training sessions, accelerator workshops, and enablement experiences that help teams adopt product management practices.


* Support business leads, Digital Product Managers, business analysts, technology leads, design, data, and engineering team members in understanding how DPOM applies to their work.


* Create learning experiences that are practical, interactive, and grounded in real product scenarios.


* Continuously improve training and accelerator content based on feedback, adoption barriers, and maturity insights.


Partnership and Enterprise Enablement


* Partner with Product Management Catalysts to convert embedded engagement learnings into reusable examples, templates, playbook updates, and training materials.


* Partner with Product Operations colleagues to use maturity and adoption insights to identify where teams need clearer guidance or stronger enablement and to ensure tools, workflows, and AI\-enabled product practices are reflected in playbook materials and accelerators.


* Partner with Product Management Hub, business functions, digital product leadership, technology leaders, Agile Enablement, Change Management, and other enabling teams to socialize and scale DPOM guidance.

* Demonstrated ability to translate complex concepts into clear, practical guidance, templates, training materials, and reusable tools.

jobs.title: Manager - Commercial Forecasting
jobs.description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-257197 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 29, 2026 CATEGORY: Operations
**Manager – Commercial Forecasting, BAI**


**Role Name:** Manager of Forecasting, BAI


**Department Name:** Business Analytics \& Insights (BAI)


**Role GCF:** 5


**ABOUT AMGEN**


Amgen is committed to unlocking the potential of biology for patients suffering from serious illnesses by discovering, developing, manufacturing, and delivering innovative human therapeutics. This approach begins by using tools like advanced human genetics to unravel the complexities of disease and understand the fundamentals of human biology. A biotechnology pioneer since 1980, Amgen has grown to be one of the world’s leading independent biotechnology companies, reaching millions of patients around the world and developing a pipeline of medicines with breakaway potential.


**ABOUT THE ROLE**


**Role Description:**


The Business Analytics \& Insights team at Amgen plays a pivotal role as a strategic partner to many cross functional teams such as Commercial, Medical, Finance, R\&D, Corp Affairs, offering data\-backed insights crucial for driving the success of Amgen’s products and portfolio. As a **Manager, Forecasting** at Amgen India, you will play a key role in delivering actionable, data\-driven insights to support decision\-making across therapeutic areas. This role supports global pipeline assets and requires flexibility in collaborating across geographies—including partners in the U.S., Portugal, and internal contract teams in India. The ideal candidate will possess strong pharmaceutical forecasting and analytics experience, high data fluency, and strong written \& verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively across multiple stakeholders groups \& geographies.


This role reports to the Senior Manager of Forecasting and operates within the broader framework of Business Analytics \& Insights (BAI).


*This role is for Amgen’s India Hyderabad Office. You will work on\-site a minimum of 4 days a week.*


**Key Responsibilities:**


* **Forecast Development:**
	+ Build, maintain, and enhance Excel\-based forecast models (patient, sales, Rx\-based, revenue).
	+ Support pipeline forecasts across various BUs (final therapeutic area assignment TBD).
	+ Assist in development of long\-range plans and annual operating plans.
* **Analytics and Insight Generation:**
	+ Interpret large datasets from internal systems, syndicated sources, and custom analytics.
	+ Apply business judgment founded on knowledge of pharma/biotech industry and Amgen products / business to integrate market dynamics, competitor insights, and assumptions into forecasts and communicate forecast results \& rationale effectively to a diverse group of stakeholders.
* **Stakeholder and Cross Functional Team Collaboration:**
	+ Collaborate with forecasting teams in the U.S., India and Portugal to align on methodology and deliverables.
	+ Partner with internal India contract workers to drive standardization and execution of model builds.
	+ Closely work with cross functional teams representing Commercial, Finance, Medical, Value \& Access, Analytics, Insights, and CI
	+ Demonstrate \& model Amgen value of being respectful to others and to a diverse working environment.
* **Process \& Capability Enablement:**
	+ Contribute to building new forecasting capabilities in Amgen India.
	+ Help develop reusable tools, templates, and forecasting frameworks.
* **Technology \& Innovation:**
	+ Leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, agentic research platforms) to enhance speed and depth of insights.
	+ Stay up to date with forecasting best practices, including probabilistic modeling, digital workflows and AI tools \& capabilities.

Minimum Qualifications:


* Bachelor’s degree and 8 to 13 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical forecasting or commercial analytics

### **Preferred Qualifications:**


* Expertise in patient\-based and demand\-based forecasting
* High proficiency in Excel and working knowledge of Python/SQL is a plus
* Familiarity with syndicated pharmaceutical data sources (e.g., IQVIA, Evaluate, internal CRM systems)
* Experience using generative AI tools to aid insight generation or automate workflows
* Strong collaboration skills, including experience working in cross\-cultural virtual teams
* Project management skills \& ability to manage multiple projects effectively in a fast\-paced environment

At Amgen, our mission is to serve patients. We recruit the best talent, build an environment that facilitates career growth, and provide staff with the opportunity to make significant contributions to patients and our business.


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**


Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.


We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

Adaptability and ability to quickly learn new business domains.

at insightsoftware

Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
  
  

This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days per week in the office and 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within a commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.The Associate Director, Technical Product Owner – Automation Material Master Stewardship is a high\-impact, hybrid leadership role. It requires a rare blend of deep Material Master Data domain expertise and advanced technical product management capabilities.
  
  

Operating at the intersection of supply chain operations, enterprise IT, and digital innovation, this individual will own the technical roadmap for our core data creation and maintenance platforms (specifically Syniti / DSP and its complex integrations into SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).
  
  

**The roles mission is twofold:**  

* Material Master Domain Leadership Tool Ownership: Act as the technical and operational authority for the global Material Master data model in our stewardship tools. You will ensure these systems operate with high reliability, comply with rigid data standards, and evolve through structured releases to support complex supply chain and manufacturing activities.
* Process Automation Workflow Re\-engineering: Partner with Global Data Steward Leads, Quality, and IT teams to systematically transition stewardship activities from manual, high\-touch execution to intelligent, streamlined, and automated workflows.


As a senior technical leader within the Hyderabad Tech Center, you will leverage local technical talent while maintaining global alignment to drive operational excellence, GxP compliance, and modern automation practices (including generative AI and workflow orchestration).
  
  

What Will You Do in This Role
  
  

1\. Material Master Data Domain Governance Platform Ownership
  
  

**Govern the Material Master Data Model:** Serve as the technical custodian for the Material Master data structure within our stewardship tools, ensuring a deep understanding of master data dependencies, taxonomy, and downstream impacts on manufacturing and logistics.
  
**Own the Tooling Ecosystem:** Act as the Technical Product Owner for data creation, change management, and validation tooling (such as Syniti/DSP and associated middleware connecting into SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).
  
**Align Business Logic with Tech:** Translate complex Material Master requirements (e.g., global vs. local views, Plant/Storage Location parameters, Bill of Materials (BOM) configurations, and regulatory metadata) into precise technical specifications and tool rules.
  
**Backlog Release Management:** Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, feature prioritization, and release roadmaps in close coordination with IT delivery engineers, architecture teams, and global business stewards.
  
  

2\. Process Re\-Engineering, Simplification Automation
  
  

**End\-to\-End Material Workflow Optimization:** Deep\-dive into existing material stewardship processes (such as first\-time material code creation, changes, and plant extensions) to eliminate manual bottlenecks, redundant pre\-checks, and handoff delays.
  
**Intelligent Automation Delivery:** Design, evaluate, and implement automation solutions across the material lifecycle, utilizing business rule engines, automated validation scripts, API integrations, and low\-code orchestration platforms.
  
**AI GenAI Integration:** Spearhead the practical adoption of generative AI (e.g., Gemini) and machine learning capabilities to assist data stewards in automated data validation, material request interpretation, anomaly detection, and auto\-generated documentation.
  
**Industry Best Practices:** Benchmark external master data management (MDM) and supply chain automation frameworks to keep our operating model forward\-looking and scalable.
  
  

3\. Quality, GxP Compliance Data Integrity
  
  

**Quality Validation Partnership:** Partner closely with Quality Assurance, Computer Systems Validation (CSV), and Regulatory teams to ensure all tooling enhancements, automation bots, and scripts meet strict GxP and audit standards.
  
**Automated Data Quality Controls:** Build automated, GxP\-compliant data governance pre\-checks, validation rules, and mandatory approval workflows directly into the tooling UI to enforce data integrity at the moment of entry.
  
**Audit Readiness Traceability:** Ensure full lifecycle traceability, change control documentation, and audit trail reliability for all automated and system\-assisted data operations.
  
  

4\. Global Partnership, Location Synergy Team Upskilling
  
  

**Bridge IT and Stewardship Operations:** Serve as the primary technical liaison in Hyderabad, connecting local IT/software product development with global data stewardship leaders and supply chain operations.
  
**Drive Change Adoption:** Partner with Global Data Leads and operational managers to design rollout plans, training materials, and change\-management programs for new automated ways of working.
  
**Technical Mentorship:** Foster an automation\-first culture across the Hyderabad stewardship hub, coaching team members on digital tools, prompt engineering, and automated testing practices.

CSE enables organizations to enforce least\-privilege access policies across managed and unmanaged devices, continuously verifying user identity, device posture, and contextual signals before granting access to private applications, SaaS resources, and internet destinations. This is a high\-growth, strategically critical product line at the center of SonicWall’s SASE transformation.

jobs.description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own and evolve our marketing technology and email lifecycle platform. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, marketing operations, and data privacy driving the roadmap for our Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) ecosystem, email campaign platforms, and consent/preference management (including OneTrust Preference Center) while contributing to broader digital marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with hands\-on technical fluency in SFMC, email marketing best practices, and privacy\-compliant customer communication frameworks.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the end\-to\-end product roadmap for the email marketing and marketing automation platform (SFMC), aligning with business goals and customer engagement strategy.
* Partner with marketing, CRM, legal, and compliance teams to design and manage subscription and consent workflows using OneTrust Preference Center.
* Define and prioritize product requirements (PRDs/user stories) for email journeys, automation workflows, and personalization capabilities within SFMC.
* Collaborate with engineering and MarTech teams to integrate SFMC, OneTrust, and other digital marketing tools into a unified customer data and communication ecosystem.
* Drive consent management and preference center enhancements to ensure compliance with GDPR, CCPA, CAN\-SPAM, and other global privacy regulations.
* Analyze campaign performance, deliverability metrics, and subscriber preference data to identify opportunities for optimization.
* Lead cross\-functional stakeholder alignment across Marketing, Legal, Data Privacy, Engineering, and Customer Experience teams.
* Define KPIs and success metrics for email engagement, list health, opt\-in/opt\-out rates, and preference center adoption.
* Support broader digital marketing initiatives including campaign personalization, audience segmentation, and channel orchestration.
* Manage the product backlog, sprint planning, and release cycles in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Stay current with SFMC platform updates, OneTrust feature releases, and evolving data privacy regulations to proactively adapt the roadmap.
* Create documentation, training materials, and enablement content for internal stakeholders on platform capabilities.



**Primary Skills (Must\-Have)** 



* **Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC):** 
 Deep hands\-on experience with Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder, and Content Builder.
* **OneTrust Preference Center:** 
 Proven experience configuring, managing, or integrating OneTrust Preference Center for subscription management, consent capture, and privacy compliance workflows.
* **Email Campaign Management:** 
 Strong background in designing, executing, and optimizing email marketing campaigns, including segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, and automated journeys.
* **Product Management Fundamentals:** 
 Solid grounding in Agile/Scrum methodologies, product roadmapping, backlog management, and writing clear PRDs/user stories.
* **Requirement Gathering \& Documentation:** 
 Ability to translate business and compliance needs into detailed technical and functional requirements.
* **Data\-Driven Decision Making:** 
 Experience analyzing campaign and platform metrics (open rates, CTR, deliverability, opt\-in/opt\-out trends) to inform product decisions.
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Demonstrated ability to align Marketing, Legal, Privacy, and Engineering teams around a shared roadmap.
* **Email Deliverability \& Compliance:** 
 Working knowledge of CAN\-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, CASL, and email authentication standards (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).



**Secondary Skills (Good\-to\-Have)** 



* **General Digital Marketing:** 
 Familiarity with SEO/SEM, paid social, display advertising, and multi\-channel campaign orchestration.
* **CRM/CDP Familiarity:** 
 Working knowledge of Salesforce Sales/Service Cloud, or customer data platforms (CDPs) that integrate with SFMC.
* **SQL \& AMPscript:** 
 Basic to intermediate scripting skills for data extensions, audience queries, and dynamic content personalization in SFMC.
* **Other ESPs/MAPs:** 
 Exposure to other marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Braze, or Iterable.
* **Privacy \& Consent Tech Ecosystem:** 
 Awareness of other consent management platforms (CMPs) or privacy tech tools beyond OneTrust.
* **UX/UI Sensibility:** 
 An eye for user experience in designing intuitive preference center and email interaction flows.
* **API \& Integrations Knowledge:** 
 Understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware tools used to connect SFMC, OneTrust, and other systems.
* **Certifications:** 
 SFMC certifications (Email Specialist, Marketing Cloud Consultant) and/or OneTrust certification are a strong plus.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field (MBA preferred).
* 6–10 years of overall experience, with at least 3\+ years in a Product Manager role focused on MarTech, CRM, or email marketing platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud is required; experience with OneTrust or similar consent/preference management tools is highly preferred.
* Prior experience working in regulated industries (e.g., finance, healthcare, insurance) with strict data privacy requirements is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams.

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**About Optum**
 Optum specializes in the delivery, clinical management, and affordability of prescription medications and consumer health products. As part of Optum, we leverage technology, data, and clinical expertise to create exceptional experiences, improve health outcomes, and help make the healthcare system work better for everyone.
   

  

 As a Senior Digital Product Manager, you will lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of critical digital capabilities that power OptumRx member experiences. You will partner with business, engineering, architecture, and operations teams to define product requirements, prioritize features, and deliver scalable solutions across Identity, Authentication, SSO, Member Profile, Eligibility, and API platforms.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines solid product management expertise with technical acumen and experience delivering customer\-focused healthcare digital products.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Own product strategy, roadmap, priorities, and backlog for assigned digital and platform capabilities
* Translate business and customer needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature specifications
* Lead product delivery for Identity \& Access Management, Login, Registration, Single Sign\-On (SSO), Member Profile, Eligibility, and API\-based capabilities
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to evaluate solutions, technical dependencies, scalability, security, and integration requirements
* Drive product discovery, backlog readiness, release planning, and prioritization decisions
* Manage stakeholder alignment and cross\-functional dependencies across multiple teams
* Define measurable outcomes and leverage customer, operational, and technical insights to drive roadmap decisions
* Communicate product vision, priorities, risks, and trade\-offs to technical and business stakeholders
* Support production platforms by prioritizing enhancements, modernization efforts, resiliency improvements, and defect resolution
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, MCA, or related technical discipline
* 7\+ years of Product Manager/Product Owner experience, including healthcare technology or digital healthcare platforms
* Experience creating product roadmaps, user stories, acceptance criteria, wireframes, and MVP definitions
* Experience working in Agile environments using Jira, Rally, Aha!, or similar product management tools
* Solid analytical, stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience
+ OptumRx, PBM, healthcare consumer platforms, or healthcare informatics experience
+ Identity \& Access Management (IAM), Login, Registration, Authentication, and SSO platforms
+ API\-driven products, system integrations, and cloud\-native digital platforms
+ Leading digital transformation and modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy to cloud\-native architectures
+ Delivering personalized member experiences through identity, profile, and eligibility services

* Proven experience owning end\-to\-end product lifecycle management
* Experience delivering scalable, customer\-centric digital products in healthcare and regulated industries
* Solid understanding of APIs, integrations, authentication flows, and enterprise platforms
* Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across complex, cross\-functional environments


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone \- of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income \- deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

Formulates and executes long\-term roadmaps for cost/profit control. Promotes use of new technologies and industry\-leading trends. **Job Location**
 HYDERABAD OFFICE INDIA PSC PGH
   

  

**Job Description**
 P\&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.
   

  

**Dedication from Us:** 
 You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.
   

  

**What we Offer:** 
 Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day\-to\-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the centre, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Digital Product Manager to join our Digital Products team and build digital products and capabilities that solve meaningful business problems. This role is designed for a professional with prior technology experience who can connect business needs with technology solutions and translate strategy into products that deliver measurable outcomes.
   

  

 You will work at the intersection of business, technology, data, users, and AI. You will understand user and business needs, shape product strategy, prioritize opportunities, work closely with engineering and technology teams, and drive products from discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

**Drive Product Delivery**

* Create clarity on requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Track delivery progress, proactively address risks and blockers, and ensure commitments remain aligned to product priorities.


**Influence Stakeholders \& Drive Change**
* Build alignment among stakeholders with different priorities, perspectives, and levels of technical understanding.
* Influence without relying solely on formal authority and create commitment around priorities, decisions, and trade\-offs.
* Drive change management through stakeholder engagement, communication, training, adoption, and feedback loops.
* Anticipate resistance and create practical approaches to move users and stakeholders toward adoption.
* Act as a trusted partner and 'go\-to' person for the products and initiatives you own.


**Build Data\- and AI\-Enabled Products**
* Identify opportunities where data, analytics, AI, GenAI, automation, or digital technologies can improve business outcomes.
* Work with data and technology teams to ensure products are built on trusted, accessible, and appropriately governed information.
* Explore AI\-enabled experiences and workflows that help people access information, make better decisions, and reduce repetitive work.
* Ensure AI and automation capabilities are introduced with appropriate human oversight, controls, and accountability.


**Drive Adoption \& Value Realization**
* Define product KPIs, adoption metrics, user experience measures, and value metrics.
* Use product usage and business performance signals to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop stakeholder engagement and adoption plans for new capabilities.
* Create feedback mechanisms that continuously bring user and business insights back into product development.
* Ensure products deliver measurable value beyond initial launch.


**Partner with Technology \& External Teams**
* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, data, design, cybersecurity, IT, and vendor teams.
* Manage technology and business dependencies required to deliver product outcomes.
* Partner with vendors and external technology providers where required, ensuring clarity of outcomes, delivery expectations, and accountability.
* Contribute to solution design, testing, release planning, reliability, security, data quality, and long\-term sustainability.

jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

The Opportunity
  
Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
  
Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. Each Tech Center is supported by a focused group of leaders who invest in the well\-being of our people and work together across locations to optimize global connections and continuously share and improve best practices.
  
  

* This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (at least 3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.

We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on engineering leader to join the Veeva Platform Center of Efficiency asAssociate Director, Veeva Platform Engineering Lead. jobs.title: Lead II - Enterprise Solutions (ServiceNow Business Analyst)
jobs.description:
**Role description**  

ServiceNow Business Analyst


**Experience:** 5\-7 Years

  


Job Summary



We are seeking an experienced **ServiceNow Business Analyst** to support the ongoing enhancement and optimization of the ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate will play a key role in gathering and documenting business requirements, analyzing defects and enhancement requests, managing product backlogs, supporting solution design, and ensuring successful delivery of ServiceNow capabilities.



The candidate will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring business requirements are translated into effective ServiceNow solutions while supporting Agile delivery, testing, and release activities.



Key Responsibilities


### **Business Analysis \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Partner with business stakeholders, Product Owners, development teams, architects, and operational teams to understand business objectives and requirements.
* Analyze defects, enhancement requests, and new ServiceNow capability requirements.
* Lead discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, process walkthroughs, and solution discussions.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business and technical teams.
* Assess business impacts and support stakeholder communication throughout the project lifecycle.

### **Requirements Gathering \& Documentation**


* Elicit, document, and maintain:
	+ Business Requirements
	+ Functional Requirements
	+ User Stories
	+ Acceptance Criteria
	+ Business Rules
	+ Process Flows
	+ Data Requirements
	+ Integration Requirements
	+ Non\-Functional Requirements
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories for ServiceNow development teams.
* Maintain end\-to\-end requirements traceability from analysis through development, testing, and deployment.
* Produce high\-quality documentation supporting project governance and delivery activities.

### **Process Analysis \& Solution Design**


* Analyze existing ServiceNow processes and identify opportunities for optimization and automation.
* Support design and enhancement of:
	+ Case Creation \& Categorization
	+ Case Lifecycle Management
	+ Assignment \& Routing
	+ Priorities \& Entitlements
	+ SLA Management \& Escalations
	+ Customer Communications
	+ Agent Workspace Processes
	+ Customer Portals \& Self\-Service Capabilities
	+ Reports \& Dashboards
* Collaborate with architects and developers to validate solution approaches and ensure alignment with business goals.

### **Agile Delivery \& Backlog Management**


* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, demos, and retrospectives.
* Work closely with Product Owners to prioritize requirements and manage the product backlog.
* Provide functional clarification during development activities.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across Agile delivery processes.

### **Testing \& Release Support**


* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning and execution.
* Define and review test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and business test cases.
* Assist in defect management, root cause analysis, and issue resolution.
* Coordinate business sign\-off activities.
* Support release planning, deployment readiness, and post\-release validation activities.


Required Qualifications


* 5\-7 years of overall experience with relevant Business Analysis experience.
* Experience working on **ServiceNow** or comparable enterprise workflow platforms.
* Strong expertise in requirements elicitation, process analysis, and stakeholder management.
* Proven experience creating:
	+ BRDs
	+ FRDs
	+ User Stories
	+ Acceptance Criteria
	+ Process Maps
	+ Functional Documentation
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and delivery frameworks.
* Experience managing product backlogs and participating in sprint ceremonies.

Overview:
**Overview**

**Product Owner**

 **BASIC SUMMARY:**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and execution\-focused Product Owner to support the delivery of features and enhancements within our healthcare claims administration platform. This role is responsible for translating business and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable user stories and working closely with engineering teams to ensure timely, high\-quality delivery. The ideal candidate brings healthcare domain knowledge, understands Agile processes, and is comfortable using AI\-enabled tools to support requirements definition and backlog management.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring stories are well\-defined, prioritized, and aligned with sprint goals
* Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and customer\-centric
* Conduct regular backlog grooming and sprint planning in collaboration with the Scrum team
* Manage daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as an active team member

**Requirements Gathering \& User Story Development**

* Collaborate with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to gather and refine product requirements

* Coordinate with other Product Owners to manage interdependencies between features

 **Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Participate in stakeholder meetings to capture feature requests, enhancement ideas, and feedback
* Communicate updates to internal stakeholders on backlog priorities, delivery timelines, and sprint progress
* Help ensure features delivered meet customer needs and stakeholder expectations

 **Healthcare Domain Support**

* Apply working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, billing terminology, and reimbursement processes
* Support compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) in collaboration with internal teams
* Assist in translating complex healthcare requirements into understandable product features

 **MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2\+ years of product management experience; healthcare technology or claims administration preferred
* 2\+ years of experience working with AI tools for product development, requirements engineering, or business analysis preferred
* Familiarity with Agile software development and Scrum methodology
* Proficiency with Jira (or similar Agile tools) for backlog management
* AI\-Enabled Product Management
* Demonstrated experience incorporating AI tools into day\-to\-day product management activities

* Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying requirements and feedback
* High attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable working with cross\-functional teams and resolving blockers quickly
* Experience working in healthcare technology, payer operations, care management, utilization management, claims administration, or related healthcare domain

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification
* Understanding of healthcare data standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, X12 EDI)
* Experience with Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, Care Management, Clinical Review, or related payer operations workflows
* Familiarity with medical necessity determination processes
* Familiarity with InterQual, MCG, or payer\-specific clinical guidelines
* Understanding of healthcare regulatory requirements including CMS, NCQA, URAC, HIPAA, and state\-specific UM regulations
* Experience collaborating with UM nurses, Medical Directors, physician reviewers, and clinical operations teams
* Knowledge of Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and Dual Eligible healthcare programs
* Familiarity with authorization intake, clinical review, peer review, and determination workflows
* Experience with workflow engines, rules engines, or clinical decision support systems

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


As an Analyst within the Network Strategy Performance team, you will own analytics that directly shape where and how Amazon serves customers globally. You will model network scenarios spanning 100\+ sites across 40\+ countries, inform multi\-year investment decisions, and deliver insights that influence headcount allocation, site strategy, and contact routing for one of the world's largest customer service networks.  

This isn't a reporting role — you'll tackle ambiguous, high\-stakes questions: Where should we expand next? How do we balance cost\-to\-serve against customer experience across geographies? You will partner closely with Operations, Products, FP\&A, and Service Delivery teams — identifying gaps, measuring performance, and driving automation and process improvement initiatives. You will contribute to the team's AI\-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own analytical inputs for network planning — model contact allocation scenarios, site investment options, and capacity strategies across geographies. Build and maintain the frameworks that determine how millions of weekly customer contacts are distributed across the global CS network, coordinating with Finance, and Service Delivery teams to ensure alignment with cost and CX targets.
* Translate complex or ambiguous network strategy questions into structured analysis — e.g., site expansion feasibility, cost\-to\-serve trade\-offs, regional performance variance. * Communicate complex analytical insights and translate network performance data into clear narratives for Finance, Service delivery and senior leadership. Present analysis to leadership audiences with clarity and conviction. Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions (OP, 3YP, QXG), producing well\-structured documents that tie conclusions to business outcomes.

  

About the team  

The Network Strategy and Performance (NSP) team defines and delivers the right human\-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future\-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive\-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. **Job Role: Junior Software Engineer – Backend**


**Work Experience: 1–1\.5 Years**

We are a patient\-centric organization committed to improving access to medicines for individuals undergoing treatment for critical diseases. We understand the challenges patients face when they are unable to afford or access their prescribed medications, and we are dedicated to making sure that every patient receives the treatment they need.

  

  

Our team is passionate about improving healthcare through technology, and we are building products that solve real problems for patients, pharmacies, doctors, and our internal teams.

  

  

**Work You Will Do**


As a Junior Software Engineer – Backend, you will work with our engineering and product teams to design, build, and maintain backend services that power our customer\-facing products and internal systems.


You will primarily work with technologies such as Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, and Kubernetes, depending on the project.

  

  

We are also actively exploring AI\-powered systems and workflows across the organization. We are looking for engineers who are comfortable with traditional backend engineering but are also curious about technologies such as LLMs, AI agents, MCP, OCR/document processing, RAG, AI APIs, AI infrastructure, vector databases, and other emerging AI technologies.

* Take ownership of assigned features from understanding the problem through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 1–1\.5 years of professional software development experience, with strong internship or project experience considered for exceptional candidates.
* Good working knowledge of Node.js and backend development fundamentals.
* Familiarity with databases, preferably MongoDB, and a basic understanding of concepts such as indexing, queries, data modelling, and performance.
* Understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, asynchronous programming, and common backend architecture patterns.
* Exposure to technologies such as Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch/Solr, Docker, or Kubernetes is a strong plus, but deep expertise in every technology is not expected at this experience level.
* Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI\-assisted development tools effectively while still understanding, reviewing, debugging, and taking ownership of the code produced.
* Hands\-on exposure to AI technologies is strongly preferred. This could include personal projects, internships, hackathons, coursework, experimentation, or professional work involving LLMs, AI APIs, RAG, agents, MCP, OCR, document processing, vector databases, AI infrastructure, or similar technologies.
* A GitHub profile, portfolio, or meaningful personal project demonstrating technical curiosity and independent problem\-solving is a strong plus.
* Startup experience is a plus, but not mandatory.
  

  

**What We Are Looking For**


We are looking for someone who can combine solid software engineering fundamentals with curiosity about AI.

  

  

AI tools are becoming increasingly capable of writing code, but we believe strong engineers will remain valuable because they can understand problems, reason about systems, make trade\-offs, and take responsibility for outcomes.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


About Amazon.com  

Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.  

About the Role  

Team Manager, Account Management, North America (NA), Work Timings: 3pm\-12am IST  

As a Manager, Account Management as part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) NA Team of Retail Business Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS North America vendors.  

AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative people leader to join our team. The role leads a team of Account Managers responsible for managing business growth for some of the most influential Selling Partners (vendors) on Amazon, ensuring Selling Partner satisfaction with the program through a high level of service and operational standards. In this role, you will manage strategic joint business plans for Selling Partners across your team by collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new selection, merchandising, and operational improvement opportunities. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. Your team will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon. The candidate thrives in an ambiguous environment where they must develop, implement and iterate data, processes, mechanisms and guardrails to improve the customer experience. Further, the candidate is a business owner who understands the key levers to drive business growth and can operationalize those levers across their team. They have a passion for people leadership and are at their best when they’re building, developing and managing high\-performing teams. Your team will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on the strategic and operational aspects of managing the customer relationships with our vendors.  

You will lead the team to conceive, create and analyze a wide range of marketing and site merchandising efforts, to include marketing campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also you will look into strategic and operational aspects of their business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting the vendor’s business.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Responsibilities Include  

* Lead a team of Account Managers, prioritizing strategic initiatives and provide escalation support as needed.
* Success will be measured by the performance of your internal teams on input metrics and impact of vendors on creating a great customer experience for buying consumers
* Identify, action and/or provide advice on how to improve business input metrics that drive growth and improve end customer experience, in collaboration with other Amazon programs and teams.
* Manage end to end goal setting for team to align with organizational goals.
* Build relationships with Selling Partners across the portfolio; proactively build joint business plan action items and act as a point of escalation for issues, questions, and concerns.
* Act as a thought leader in defining success criteria and understand business needs of Selling Partners in an ever\-changing business environment. Contributes to and leads strategic plans and documents for the organization.
* Leads recruiting and hiring efforts across direct team and broader organization.
* Manage Selling Partner needs and monitor complexity through efficient resource allocation of Account Managers.
* Monitor Selling Partner satisfaction survey results to analyze both positive and negative feedback trends. Establish improvement plans and mange expectations with Account Managers as appropriate.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles with a focus on data analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of mentoring, leading and coaching experience

jobs.title: Director Product Management
jobs.description:
**About Target:**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.

  

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

  

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

 **About Team \& Role:**


Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross\-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

  

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

  

As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short\- and long\-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.

  

The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.

  

Further the role will be responsible for

* Driving day\-to\-day product excellence and velocity of Cross\-functional teams
* Ensuring strong alignment between global product strategy and local execution, especially faster decision making
* Elevating product thinking, maturity, innovation, and data\-driven decision\-making leveraging Digital\-first mindset.
* Serving as the site leader for product team functionally reporting to the US product leader

 **Detailed Job Description:**


Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with execution excellence, fostering strong product and engineering practices, and building high\-performing teams. This leader will transform servicing data into actionable enterprise insights, accelerate digital adoption, reduce friction across customer journeys, and create scalable, reusable platforms that strengthen loyalty, improve productivity, and unlock enterprise value.


You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback and by partnering with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to resolve execution\-related barriers.


You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, validating hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialities. You will use data and analytics to assess market context, inform decisions, evaluate product health and effectiveness, understand P\&L impact, and provide clear recommendations to key stakeholders.


You will possess or develop a strong understanding of servicing platforms and systems, including data flows, transaction sequences, relevant technologies, and design principles, to enable innovative and scalable solutions across Target.


Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

 **About you:**

* Four\-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10\+ years of product management experience, including experience leading product teams, preferably within retail, consumer, or servicing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading product\-driven business transformation.
* Experience managing product portfolios, investment priorities, budgets, financials, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, data, analytics, and digital product development.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across complex, cross\-functional organisations.
* Expertise in establishing product vision, outcome\-based roadmaps, OKRs, and success measures.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and lead high\-performing product teams.
* Expertise in agile product\-development practices, including iterative development, discovery, experimentation, and backlog management.

jobs.description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI\-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
   

  

 We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
   

  

**Want to join the leader in AI\-powered data security?**
 Cohesity is looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive execution for our Filesystem \& Storage portfolio. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role. You'll own execution for a defined area of our filesystem and storage platform spanning customer\-managed and cloud SaaS working in tight partnership with engineering, UX, and go\-to\-market teams, directly with customers across the globe.
   

  

**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE:**
* Own the roadmap and PRDs for your area within Filesystem \& Storage driving innovation and adoption across \- Enterprise file systems and storage protocols (NFS, SMB, S3, etc.), Scale\-out and distributed storage architecture, Data mobility, interoperability, and platform performance, Storage efficiency, resiliency, and scalability at petabyte scale, Cloud/hybrid\-cloud extensions, and adjacent agentic AI\-driven data management.
* Go deep with engineering, daily — understand system internals well enough to drive real design conversations, not just requirements hand\-offs.
* Work through disagreements with engineering using data and trade\-off framing — not by pulling rank or escalating by default.
* Own release trade\-off calls when scope, quality, and timeline conflict, and communicate the “why” clearly.
* Stay engaged from PRD through design review, build, GA, and beyond. Shipped is the starting line, not the finish.
* Define success metrics before you ship and track them after: adoption, usage depth, retention, support tickets, NPS/CSAT.
* Be the voice of the customer — keep a constant pulse on markets, competitors, and technology trends to spot opportunities and risks early.
* Partner with Marketing on packaging, pricing input, blogs, and launch events for your area.
* Track your product after it ships — revisit adoption and quality data at 30/60/90 days and feed learnings back into the roadmap.


**You'll partner closely with:**
* A Principal PM or Head of Product for Filesystem \& Storage, aligning your execution with the broader roadmap.
* Peer PMs across adjacent areas of the Cohesity platform.
* GTM teams — Marketing, Ecosystem, Support, Enablement, Sales, and Sales Engineering.
* A progressive UX team, and a world\-class engineering team you'll work alongside daily — not just at the start and end.


**WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:**
* 7–10 years of PM experience owning and shipping complex, technical B2B/infrastructure products end to end — not just writing requirements and moving on.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with enterprise filesystems and storage (block/file/object); exposure to cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) or agentic AI is a plus, not required.
* Strong grasp of distributed systems, storage protocols, and performance/scalability trade\-offs — you can read an architecture diagram and hold your own in a design review.
* A track record of delivery you can walk through in detail: what you shipped, why, the impact, and how you measured it.
* A customer\-obsessed, ownership\-driven philosophy — “shipped” is the starting line, not the finish line.
* Experience partnering with Marketing on launches, packaging/pricing, and blogs — and a habit of tracking a product after it ships.
* MBA, cloud certifications, or exposure to agentic AI/LLM system design are a plus, not a requirement.

jobs.description:
**Overview**
 AI is becoming a core part of enterprise infrastructure, and many customers want reliable ways to run inference close to their data, systems, and operations. Windows Server has a solid opportunity to make that easier for organizations that already depend on Microsoft platforms.
   

  

 In this
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 role, you will help shape product experiences that simplify how customers configure, run, monitor, and manage AI inference on Windows Server. The work sits at the intersection of AI workloads, datacenter infrastructure, hardware acceleration, enterprise management, and customer trust. This is a high\-impact role for a PM who enjoys technical depth, customer empathy, and product building.
   

  

 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define customer scenarios, product requirements, and roadmap priorities for Windows Server AI inferencing experiences.
* Turn complex infrastructure workflows into simple, guided experiences for administrators and developers.
* Partner with engineering on configuration, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management capabilities.
* Use customer feedback, telemetry, and field input to make clear product tradeoffs and ship focused improvements.
* Help the product work well across enterprise hardware environments, including GPU\-accelerated and CPU\-based scenarios.
* Build crisp product narratives, demos, documentation, and success measures that help customers and field teams understand the value.
* Collaborate across engineering, design, documentation, sales, hardware partners, and go\-to\-market teams.


**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's Degree AND 5\+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
+ OR equivalent experience.


**Other Requirements:** 
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
   

  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of product management experience shipping technical, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise products, or equivalent engineering\-to\-PM experience.
* Experience with AI inference platforms, products, services, or related AI infrastructure technologies.
* Solid technical judgment and ability to work credibly with engineers on systems, APIs, and infrastructure tradeoffs.
* Experience converting ambiguous customer needs into requirements, roadmap decisions, and shipped outcomes.
* Deep experience in AI/ML inference, model serving, developer platforms, distributed systems, datacenter infrastructure, cloud, edge, or on\-premises environments.
* Experience working with OEMs, silicon or accelerator providers, ISVs, systems integrators, or other ecosystem partners.
* Ability to drive cross\-functional execution across engineering, design, documentation, field, and go\-to\-market teams.
* Data\-informed product thinking using telemetry, customer feedback, and rapid iteration.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Team**
 Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e\-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers \- ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
   

  

 Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
   

  

 We are driven by a ‘user\-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ \& delivery \- not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
   

  

 But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start\-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross\-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.
   

  

**What Will You Do**
* Market \& Customer Understanding: Understand the e\-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification \& Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology\-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross\-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go\-to\-Market Planning: Create a go\-to\-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption \& Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3\-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.


**What You Will Need**
* Overall experience of 7\+ yrs with atleast 4\+ yrs in product management in a tech\-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

jobs.description:
**Description**
 Advertising is a strategic bet for Amazon and is one of the fastest growing business units within Amazon India. Sponsored Ads is our flagship performance ads product and the backbone of our Advertising business. We are strengthening our offering by continuously building and enhancing product capability to improve shopper engagement and advertiser experience.
   

  

 We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager (Tech) to own monetization charter and grow Ads business in India .
   

  

 You will work with a dedicated engineering and ML team and will heavily collaborate with stakeholders across WW, India and emerging countries. You will manage the complete business of your product area including establishing key metrics, setting and meeting goals on business/product metrics, advertiser engagement, and retention. You will be driving key metrics pertaining to advertisers, shoppers and Amazon.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Identify product opportunities for the advertisement business using data, customer engagement studies and anecdotes. Create detailed near\-term and longer\-term roadmap for product.
* Build product capabilities that help improve both advertiser experience (e.g. impressions, sales, ease of ad campaign management) and shopper engagement (e.g. Ad engagement, Ad quality etc.).
* Build ads supply, formats, sourcing and ads relevance enhancements.
* Use ML\-techniques to build innovative solutions.
* Play a key role in go\-to\-market of product features by influencing Marketing narrative and Sales / Account Management processes.
* Manage all aspects of project including organizing and planning, estimating, managing resources, tracking, risk \& opportunity, quality, documentation and change management.
* Work closely with Tech and ML teams to create execution plans and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs.
* Engage frequently with stakeholders (WW, India and Emerging markets) to identify collaboration opportunities


**About The Team**
 You will be part of the IN Ads DSP product team, reporting to the IN Ads product leader. You will have a dedicated Tech team (SDEs, TPM and SDM) for your Ad product and shared ML resources to help you innovate.
   

  

 You will engage with other key teams in India Ads like Demand, Marketing, Sales and Account Management teams. Beyond these, you will have ample opportunities to interact and influence WW Product, Tech, Applied Science teams etc.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning
* Experience with end to end product delivery


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
   

  

 Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Our vision:** 
 A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 Wrike is seeking a highly adaptable Senior Product Manager to join our global product organization. As a strategic leader, you will own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of your product area, driving measurable business impact and solving complex problems for millions of users.
   

  

 We are looking for a versatile generalist who is comfortable tackling diverse challenges as business needs evolve, but who is ready to immediately dive into a high\-impact, transformative domain:
 **AI\-driven Work Intake** 
 .
   

  

**Your Impact:**
* Deliver Innovation: Validate and ship solutions that revolutionize how work flows into systems, saving customers time and boosting work quality for both administrators and end\-users. Evolve Wrike's work intake experience through platform and agentic capabilities within your first 6 months.
* Drive Discovery \& Vision: Deeply understand customer workflows and underlying business pains to uncover emerging needs. Paint a compelling product vision and propose pragmatic, innovative solutions — whether through advanced AI, platform capabilities, or a combination of both — that best solve the core problem.
* Adapt \& Scale: Act as a flexible product leader capable of pivoting to new, critical product domains as our overarching business strategy evolves.

* Practical AI experience: Hands\-on experience with leveraging AI technologies to streamline work and experience with the creation of AI\-powered features.
* Collaboration Skills: Ability to work well with cross\-functional teams and communicate effectively with many partners across different parts of the organization.
* Advanced English language skills (written and spoken), with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.


**Standout Qualities:**
* Experience in the enterprise collaboration, project management, or work management domain.
* Proven experience building and delivering AI or LLM\-driven product experiences to market.
* Demonstrated ability to balance the complex configuration needs of system administrators with a frictionless experience for end\-users.


**Team Dynamics:**
* You will operate within a core "Product Trio" model (Product, UX, and Engineering) to guide a tight\-knit Scrum team of 6\-8 engineers and QA to deliver the product innovations.
* You will partner heavily across the organization, pulling in expertise from specialized roles such as AI/ML engineers, Data Scientists, Product Analytics, and Go\-to\-Market teams to ensure successful launches.
* You will have direct access to enterprise customers and admins to conduct continuous research, test early prototypes, and validate hypotheses through tight feedback loops.
* The opportunity to operate at the bleeding edge of AI and work management, blending complex, enterprise\-grade capabilities with modern, intelligent user experiences.

 Standard (Mon\-Fri)

 Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:
   

  

* Customer focused, with strong qualitative and quantitative research skills, able to talk to the market and present informative analysis

 Who we are looking for:
   

  

* Master’s, PhD level or Business education is advantageous.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Life at UiPath**
 The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category\-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
   

  

 To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self\-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast\-moving, fast\-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
   

  

 Could that be you?
   

  

**Your mission**
 You'll own one of the platform layers that powers agentic automation. This is a layer that every other product on the platform \- agents, workflows, and RPA \- depends on to do its job. Your charter is to make it the obvious, trusted choice for developers and customers in the agentic era, and to prove that value with real production adoption.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that pairs high autonomy with high accountability. You will set the vision, own the roadmap, get into the technical design with engineering, sit in customer conversations directly, and carry your story all the way into the field.
   

  

**The platform you'll shape**
 You'll join the team building the foundational layers of UiPath's agentic platform, the layers every agent, process, and workflow depends on.
   

  

* Data Fabric \- the data and context layer. Gives agents and workflows governed, real\-time access to enterprise data, modeling raw records into business entities and a shared semantic layer automations can reason over. The work ahead: turning data into connected context agents can navigate.
* Human\-in\-the\-Loop \- the human\-judgment layer. Whenever an agent, process, or workflow needs a person to review, approve, or handle an exception, it brings the right human in: designing the review interface, routing the task, and delivering it wherever people work. The work ahead: making it first\-class for the agentic era.


**What You'll Do At UiPath**
* Own the vision and roadmap for your platform layer, making sharp tradeoff decisions on complex, ambiguous problems, and proposing a clear path forward rather than just surfacing the ambiguity.
* Drive go\-to\-market. Partner with marketing and sales on positioning, enablement, and demos; create demand and get your wins in front of the field and customers.
* Be the customer's champion. Engage directly in account conversations, get deep into real scenarios, and turn what you learn into validated use cases and roadmap decisions.
* Own outcomes end to end. Take accountability from problem definition through launch, adoption, and the metrics that prove value (e.g. production adoption, task success rate, agent reliability).
* Get technical. Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with engineering on design decisions, dogfood the product yourself, and stay credible on the underlying technology.
* Make it agent\-ready. Translate the fast\-moving agent landscape (LLMs, coding agents, orchestration frameworks, MCP, evals) into a coherent UiPath point of view and a shipping product.
* Raise the bar for the broader product team through thought leadership, a strong point of view in forums, and mentoring.


**What You'll Bring To The Team**
* 8\+ years of product management on technical / platform / developer products, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* A builder's instinct. You've shipped infrastructure that other builders rely on, and you'd rather prototype and dogfood than write a spec and wait.
* Technical depth. You go deep on technical design with engineering and are comfortable in the product yourself, not just managing from the roadmap.
* Hands\-on with AI, not conceptual. You have built or integrated AI/ML into live products yourself, and you use LLM\-based tools (copilots, coding agents, prototyping tools) in your own daily work. Building products for \- and with \- agents is a fundamental expectation.
* A genuine customer\-champion mindset. You seek out direct customer conversations and let real scenarios drive what you build.
