jobs.description:
**Role** 
 \- Senior Product Manager, Fleet Management Systems (FMS)
 



**Location** 
 \- BLR/GGN
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Delhivery's freight network operates across thousands of vehicles, vendors, customers, and trips every day. Orion and our Fleet Management Systems sit at the center of this ecosystem—connecting demand creation, supply allocation, procurement, trip execution, tracking, documentation, and financial closure.
 



 As Senior Product Manager for FMS, you will own products that make freight operations faster, more automated, and more efficient. You will work at the intersection of customers, operations, supply, engineering, data, and AI—simplifying complex workflows and progressively moving them from manual coordination to intelligent, system\-driven execution.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complicated operational problems and turning them into scalable products.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Own the roadmap, not just the backlog — Define product strategy and roadmap across freight and fleet workflows from demand/indent creation and supply\-demand matching to trip execution, tracking, documentation, and closure. Define clear business and product KPIs and own outcomes.
* Automate operations using AI — Identify workflows currently dependent on calls, emails, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, or manual decision\-making and redesign them using AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent recommendations.
* Go deep into freight operations — Understand how customers raise demand, how supply teams source vehicles, how vendors bid and allocate capacity, and how trips are executed on ground. Spend time with operations, vendors, drivers, and customers to understand where systems diverge from reality.
* Drive measurable operational outcomes — Use data to identify bottlenecks and measure improvements in metrics such as turnaround time, automation/adoption, vehicle placement, tracking compliance, vendor performance, and operational productivity.
* Build for scale and reliability — Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design systems that can handle complex workflows, integrations, real\-time events, and large transaction volumes without creating operational fragility.
* Drive execution across teams — Work closely with engineering, operations, supply, business, finance, and external partners. Navigate competing priorities, make trade\-offs, and take initiatives from problem discovery through rollout and adoption.



  





**What You Bring** 



* 4\+ years of product management experience, preferably in logistics, supply chain, fleet management, marketplaces, B2B platforms, or a fast\-paced internet company.
* Strong product fundamentals with demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, quantify their impact, and translate them into scalable products.
* Strong operational instinct—you are comfortable understanding workflows on the ground rather than designing products only from meeting rooms.
* Hands\-on SQL and data skills—you should be comfortable pulling and analysing your own data, building funnels, identifying failure patterns, and using data to challenge assumptions.
* Practical fluency with modern AI tooling—LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, RAG, and AI\-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar environments.
* Strong systems thinking. You can reason across workflows involving customers, vendors, vehicles, drivers, payments, documents, APIs, and multiple internal systems rather than optimizing one screen in isolation.
* Ability to influence across teams without relying on authority and to drive adoption after the product has shipped.



  





**Why This Role** 




 Freight operations have traditionally depended heavily on people coordinating through calls, messages, spreadsheets, and fragmented systems. At Delhivery's scale, the opportunity is to fundamentally change that.
 



 FMS is evolving from a system that records freight operations into a platform that can increasingly understand demand, recommend decisions, automate coordination, and manage execution.
 



 This role gives you the opportunity to build that transformation at scale—combining logistics, marketplaces, data, and AI to redefine how freight moves.

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

* **Validation Logic:** Document validation logic and exception\-handling procedures for critical datasets.

**Data Monitoring and Reporting**


* **Continuous Monitoring:** Actively monitor data pipelines, ETL processes, and dashboards to proactively identify DQ issues and operational anomalies.
* **DQ Dashboards/Scorecards:** Develop and maintain data quality metrics and scorecards to report on data accuracy trends to leadership.
* **Alerting:** Set up automated alerts for breach of data quality thresholds.

**Data Concern Remediations**


* **Issue Resolution:** Identify, document, and triage data quality issues through a tracking system.
* **Remediation Action Plans:** Develop and execute remediation plans, including data cleansing efforts and automated corrections.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with data stewards, IT, and developers to resolve data issues and implement long\-term solutions.

We are looking for a highly results\-oriented and process\-driven Director – Project Management. This role will function as the strategic engine driving project execution for our India organization. Not just managing the timelines, this leader will be responsible for maturing our delivery ecosystem, bridging the gap between high\-level product vision and technical execution. This role requires a blend of deep technical expertise in software products, strong leadership skills, and a strategic, customer\-focused mindset. **Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary liaison between executive leadership, Engineering, and Product Owners to align delivery cycles with business goals.

* Identify bottlenecks in the SDLC and implement Lean/Agile process improvements to increase velocity without sacrificing quality.
* Define and report on metrics, including Dev estimation gaps, efforts vs actuals, slippage deviations, escaped defect rate, etc.

Work together with Product Owners to refine backlogs, ensuring user stories are “Ready” for development and meet the Definition of Done (DoD).

preferred.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Gracenote's Data Platform is the central hub for millions of pieces of TV entertainment data used daily by clients and partners worldwide. It provides the critical services that structure and model data for our editorial, ingest, and delivery systems. This data powers entertainment solutions for the top cable, OTT, CE, and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.
   

  

 We are hiring a lead product manager to own this platform from our Bengaluru engineering center. The role also owns Gracenote's content\-source\-facing products, the Gracenote ID Distribution System (GNIDS) and Gracenote View, through which content owners register content, obtain Gracenote IDs, submit first\-party metadata, and access Gracenote data. This role has a deliberate arc.
   

  

 Initially, this is a hands\-on role. You will write specs and requirements yourself, work directly with engineers and data architects, analyze data with your own queries, and build deep fluency in the platform. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work.
   

  

 As the platform and your fluency mature, the role expands into a player\-coach position, which will build and mentor a product team in India while remaining close to the platform. Candidates should be excited by both halves of this trajectory, not just the second one.
   

  

 You will be the lead product presence co\-located with our engineering organization, partnering across time zones with Dataset and Delivery Product Managers and commercial stakeholders based in the US and Europe. This is not a satellite role. It is the product anchor for our engineering center.
   

  

 An ideal candidate will have 8\+ years of Product Management experience and a proven track record of end\-to\-end ownership and delivering results.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for Gracenote's Data Platform, the system that structures and models complex TV entertainment data for internal consumers and clients alike.
* Own the Gracenote ID Distribution System (GNIDS) and Gracenote View, including requirements, backlog, delivery, and support for existing customers and partner integrations. Define how these products evolve as the platform matures.
* Work closely with Global Dataset and Delivery Product Managers to understand the business problems in creating and structuring complex entertainment data, and translate those needs into a clear, prioritized roadmap.
* Partner directly with engineering teams and Data Architects to shape data models, write detailed requirements, and drive hands\-on execution, especially in the first phase of the role.
* Define and own the platform's key input and output metrics. Establish platform SLAs and quality measures, and publish them so internal and external consumers can hold the platform accountable.
* Operate effectively across a globally distributed organization: strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US/EU stakeholders.
* Over time, hire, mentor, and grow a high\-performing product team in India while remaining an active individual contributor on the most complex platform problems.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of product management experience, including 3\+ years on platform or data products.
* Demonstrated appetite for hands\-on IC work at a senior level: writing specs, querying data, working directly in the details with engineering.
* Actively uses LLMs in day\-to\-day product work: to accelerate analysis, drive better decisions, automate repetitive PM tasks, and achieve measurable outcomes. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.


**Preferred Skills/Experience**
* Experience with TV/entertainment metadata, EPG data, content supply chains, or adjacent media data domains.
* Experience owning client\-facing web applications or APIs alongside a data platform.
* Experience partnering with Data Architects to shape complex business data into coherent, extensible, scalable structures.
* Prior experience as a hiring manager or formal people manager.
* Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL, and REST APIs; able to write or LLM\-assist your own scripts in Python or SQL to answer product questions.
* Experience working within structured, milestone\-driven development processes and delivering predictably against commitments.
* Highly metrics\-driven: able to distill a complex platform into a small set of key input and output metrics and use them to drive decisions.
* Track record of driving execution rigor in collaboration with cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication; proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Interest and aptitude for people leadership: prior mentoring, coaching, or team\-lead experience, and genuine motivation to build a team as the role grows.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree **in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems**, or **Business Administration**.
* Master’s degree preferred but not required.
* Oracle and Cloud experience.

**Experience Requirement**
--------------------------

* **10\-12 years** of experience supporting or implementing **Oracle Cloud ERP** or on\-premises financial systems.

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll be part of a global team dedicated to innovation and excellence. You will have the opportunity to grow your career by working with advanced financial systems, learning from experienced professionals, and contributing to our mission — **to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.**
